title: RFC005 §44.1 S2 Run Manifest
$comment: Closed envelope for one S2 run: the identity under which it may execute. Every field is a derivation from a frozen artefact, never a free choice -- `run_id` is derived from all the other fields (addendum A, same construction as S1's `s1run_` ids), and every hash pins the exact cohort, stage data matrix, sampler policy, exposure policy and ordered exposure plan the run is allowed to draw from. A manifest that does not hash-verify is not a manifest: the run it names has no identity. `gradient_bearing` is DECLARED, never inferred (DEC-009: an S2 run starts as `discovery`; whether it bears gradient is an owner decision frozen here).

run_id.$comment: make_id("s2run", "rfc005.s2-run-id/v1", payload without run_id and without the self-hash). Derived, never assigned.

run_seed.$comment: The seed the ordered exposure plan was built under -- the manifest and the plan must agree, because the plan is the seed-deterministic draw order this run is allowed to follow.

binding_s1_run_manifest_hash.$comment: 1.1.0 (DEC-027 D1/D2, T4b): the companion S1-format run manifest's own `s1_run_manifest_hash`, re-derived by the builder from the presented companion document (run_binding.compute_s1_run_manifest_hash over its payload without its self-hash) -- never a caller-typed value. S2 has no run manifest of its own shape for cache/policy/allowlist bindings, so every S1-side binding (cache identity, allowlist, ancestry, run_config budget) is carried by naming this companion.

cohort_hash.$comment: 1.1.0: nullable. Null iff no matrix cell with cohort == 'synthetic_p1p2' carries mass (today's S2 matrix: 100% docxcorp, synthetic mass 0) -- an unused pin is refused as a lie, and a used synthetic cell without one is refused as unpinned (DEC-027 D2).
